translated:
Rebirth and summoning, repeated again
and again. The annihilation of the soul
is an extension of that as well...
That is what is called causality.

I was reborn into your body
to witness your bravery at this very moment...

An incompetent human who is merely
a princess absorbed my Lenneth, and on top of that...

...has thrown into disarray the history
I rewrote with meticulous calculation...
